title: Resume after final commit with nothing left to dispatch
narrative: The durable coding job has fully committed when Fangore's process dies. On resume he loads the store and verifies the plan is already complete — no new dispatch and no reconciliation of an in-flight effect. Closes the crash matrix after `fangore_tdr_crash_after_reduce_before_checkpoint`. Self-revising checkpoint consumers build on this seam (see footnotes on `fangore_tdr_crash_before_intent`).
implementation: `ArmedCrashProbe` + SQLite checkpoint durable resume for coding_job effects. `CliInstrumentor` probe `transactional_durable_resume`. Unit: `tests/fixtures/transactional_durable_resume/*.json`.
validation: Harness `cli` `probe` loads `plans/crash_after_final_commit.yaml` (human-readable probe plan); hard expects on declared observation keys.
